To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the profession of public health nursing is threatened.
(a) the public health nurse (PHN) profession is threatened by a lack of professional autonomy, and (b) the PHN role has changed from a public health role, to one focused on the individual.
the changes in public health nursing in Norway are related to changes in the health system and to changes in the public health nursing profession.

the question of whether public health nursing is under threat in the Norwegian health service.
the question of whether the public health nurses in Norway have been able to maintain their profession and their professional role, despite the fact that their working conditions have changed.

public health nursing in Norway has changed considerably in the last 30-40 years.
